mapping.summary: Dealer business system for John Deere dealers
claims: Exchanges and archives files with John Deere via DTF without an on-premise server
Sends purchase orders to JDPoint via PMLink
Checks part availability across John Deere stock locations
Creates and submits warranty claims to John Deere incl. PIPs and Powergard
Receives debit and credit notes from John Deere, then forwards them to customers
Automatically matches and processes John Deere parts receipts and invoices
Imports John Deere parts price lists and substitutions, automatable
Uploads trial balance to John Deere DFA tool monthly or quarterly
Stock replenishment suggestions via Retail Parts Management and JDPrism
Imports parts lists from Parts ADVISOR
Synchronizes equipment, orders and customers with John Deere CRM
Imports JDLink data to fill operating hours on service orders
Manages service agreements via Service Admin Portal
Applies John Deere incentives and discounts to sales orders
Okta authentication down to user level
